ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 6 — Preventive Visit — Sitting Bull — True-date frame: synthetic events are moved into the patient's historical lifetime. Codes, instruments, and treatments remain modern and are anachronistic.

code.displayName: Periodic reevaluation and management of healthy individual

text.paragraph: Sitting Bull is a man of about 55 with post-traumatic arthritis of the left subtalar and talonavicular joints, small retained metal fragments in the left heel, and prediabetes, who comes for his yearly preventive visit one week after his ten-week review. The subtalar injection six weeks ago still helps, and he walks more than a mile with the brace. His stomach settled after naproxen was stopped, and he finished the omeprazole yesterday. The family is now enrolled in the food distribution program and eats more of the bison and vegetables it offers. He cannot recall any screening tests or vaccines as an adult. [S]

Next preventive visit in one year. Next scheduled visit 1886-10-26: sixteen-week review: pain, prediabetes, food and his plan for the year. [S]

Voluntary advance care planning discussion of about 20 minutes, with the interpreter and with his consent. He named a health care agent and completed a health care proxy form; the agent is recorded in the chart and is not named here. He said that what matters most to him is to remain among his people and on his land, to keep his independence, and that his own spiritual practices be respected at the end of life in the way he will direct; those practices are his and are not recorded. He would accept treatment for any condition from which he could recover. The plan will be revisited yearly or after any serious illness. [S]
